page_title: REN 5-0 ETI | Rennes v St Etienne 30/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Rough tackle by Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
88' The number of shots on goal at present is 10:0.
85' St Etienne hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
81' Booking. Gautier Larsonneur (St Etienne) receives a caution from the referee.
81' That will be all from Leo Petrot who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Pierre Cornud (St Etienne).
80' Rennes fail to score from a corner as Gautier Larsonneur (St Etienne) leaps to collect the ball.
80' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Rennes.

79' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the roof of the net, but Gautier Larsonneur pulls off a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
78' A player from Rennes commits a rough challenge. Marc Bollengier blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
78' Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) is angry with himself. The ball breaks to him but he hits the crossbar! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
77' A great pass puts Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) clear inside the box, he sidesteps the keeper but inexplicably hits his shot against the left post.
75' Jorge Sampaoli has decided to make a change. Jota (Rennes) replaces Ludovic Blas.
74' Rennes are ruled offside.
73' Rennes players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
70' The substitution is prepared. Carlos Andres Gomez (Rennes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lorenz Assignon.
70' Jorge Sampaoli decides to make a substitution. Azor Matusiwa will be replaced by Glen Kamara (Rennes).
67' 5 - 0 Goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) runs up to the ball, stops and waits for Gautier Larsonneur to commit before slotting the penalty into the bottom right corner.
67' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is going to take the penalty!
67' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) is coming onto the pitch as Pierre Ekwah cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Olivier Dall'Oglio has decided to substitute Zuriko Davitashvili and he is replaced by Mathis Amougou (St Etienne).
66' That's the end of the game for Ibrahim Sissoko, who is replaced by Lucas Stassin (St Etienne).
66' A player from St Etienne brings down an opponent and commits a foul. It's a penalty to Rennes! Let's see who's going to take it.
64' A player from St Etienne pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Albert Gronbaek (Rennes) will replace Amine Gouiri.
62' Here is a change. Mahamadou Nagida is going off and Jorge Sampaoli gives the last tactical orders to Adrien Truffert (Rennes).
61' 4 - 0 Goal! Ludovic Blas shows great vision to find Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) with a cheeky pass inside the box, and his first-time shot is precise and sails into the bottom left corner. 4:0.
57' Rennes are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
53' 3 - 0 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Ludovic Blas is pounced on by Amine Gouiri (Rennes). His close-range strike flashes past Gautier Larsonneur and into the bottom left corner. 3:0.
51' The corner is swung in but St Etienne can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
47' Jordan James (Rennes) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Gautier Larsonneur.
46' Olivier Dall'Oglio makes a half-time substitution. Ibrahima Wadji comes on in place of Louis Mouton (St Etienne).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+9' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+9' The resulting set piece from Rennes is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

45+8' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Gautier Larsonneur shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him. Now Rennes have a corner.
45+6' 2 - 0 Goal! Ludovic Blas (Rennes) places a fabulous effort into the top left corner after collecting a brilliant pass inside the box. What a strike that is!

45+5' The ball goes out of play and St Etienne will have a goal kick. Amine Gouiri (Rennes) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
45+1' Leo Ostigard (Rennes) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
45' 8 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
42' Marc Bollengier interrupts the game. One of the players from Rennes won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
41' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
39' 1 - 0 Goal! Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) puts the ball into the bottom left corner past the outstretched arm of Gautier Larsonneur.
38' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
37' The referee interrupts the game and gives a red card to Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne). He can take an early bath.
36' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
35' Referee Marc Bollengier makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty. Let’s see what happens!
35' Rennes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
34' Surely that's handball by one of the St Etienne players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
33' One of the St Etienne players unfairly tackled his opponent and conceded a foul.

29' St Etienne are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
26' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle after Amine Gouiri (Rennes) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
23' Some patient build-up play from Rennes as they look to unlock the defence.
20' Lorenz Assignon (Rennes) commits a foul and Marc Bollengier immediately signals a free kick.
17' Mathieu Cafaro (St Etienne) receives a pass on the edge of the box and attempts a lob as the keeper is off his line, but the effort crashes off the right post.
15' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) whips in a cross from the corner, but Gautier Larsonneur is well positioned and punches the ball away.
13' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
12' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Rennes comes to nothing.
10' The match can continue after the interruption.
5' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
3' Rennes are seeing far more of the ball now.
1' The first half has just begun.
Rennes will kick-off.
Marc Bollengier will officiate today.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
